name: bonsai-code
description: A Claude-style terminal coding agent for local Bonsai models (design previews first).

scripts.install-cli: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/bonsai ~/.local/bin/bonsai && echo installed ~/.local/bin/bonsai
scripts.test:binary: bun run build && BONSAI_BIN=$PWD/dist/bonsai bun test test/app.test.mjs
